name: Largest Strongly Shattered Set / Log Size Ratio (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the largest strongly shattered-set size is $n$, while the log size ratio is $\log(2^n-1)/\log(n+1)=\Theta(n/\log n)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the even-parity class $\mathcal E_n$, the log size ratio is $\log(2^{n-1}-1)/\log(n+1)=\Theta(n/\log n)$, while the largest strongly shattered-set size is $0$.
proof: The full-cube and even-parity value calculations give gaps whose ratios diverge in the two opposite directions.
